how_to_find: Ask the client for the newest file name in the supabase/migrations folder of their repo. Match its date to the list below. If they have no such folder, choose Not sure and send them the newest version steps.

versions.title: Faster install
versions.summary: Every sign-in, token and key now happens in one sitting. DNS is gone. Each step shows a time estimate. The first check uses 3 drafts, and the first 12 posts start after the install.

changes.text: DNS and the alert-route choice. Alerts use Resend's test sender.
Token and key steps moved into Part 2, each stored right after it is made
Brand step uses the research values instead of repeating the logo hunt
Launch check starts 3 drafts. A later step starts the first 12 posts
Time estimate and direct link on every step
Newsletter intake: a Gmail label script (loom-queue) is now an install step, with a test at the health check. Before this, no installed app could receive newsletters.
Daily publish sweep job (publish-approved-sweep-daily). Prismm had it; new installs did not.

results.note: 0 FAIL. Preflight does not check GMAIL_SCRIPT_URL or that the Resend account email equals the app login.
Both made with Use this template. The worker repo name is now a setting (default insightforge-worker).
All secrets stored. One login, sign-up off, Site URL set.
On Windows, Device Guard blocked the Supabase CLI. Built through the Supabase API instead (63 migrations). Step 17 now keeps install scripts on.
Same CLI block; deployed through the API. A change to a shared file must redeploy every function that uses it.
Run workflow builds the template copy. The app address comes from the repo name. Login works; sign-up is refused.
Find logo found the real logo. Outfit needs the custom font entry.
Green in 52 s. Worker and Supabase secrets stored.
App and Zernio agree on account, profile and company page. Use a Zernio account that only this business uses.
3 drafts after the worker seal-step fix (d8c767c).
Brand PNG and preview pass after worker fixes 4002487 and 7128023.
Card queue tick runs every 10 minutes (5b9533e).
The tick re-sent 3 failed draft jobs; all completed.
Published on the ReRev Labs page; provider status and link checked.
Server side works: scheduled on its slot with the image. The app needs the tab open about 30 s after Approve.
The provider post is removed, but the draft stays approved and the daily sweep schedules it again.
Sent with video after fix b0af2f0 (owner email from the login). The Resend account email must equal the app login email; a mismatch gives Resend 403.

Two QuantHub emails became source cards within 5 minutes. First try failed: an old Knowledge Loom script in the same Gmail also watched loom-queue and took the email. Every install uses the same label names, so one Gmail account can run only one intake.
Started; owner accepted without waiting for the end. 9 jobs used only 3 seeds while 9 seeds were unused, so 2 drafts failed the novelty check. Seed picking needs a fix.
Claude-run part: 28 min from preflight to live app. Keys sitting and owner clicks not measured. 20-30 min not proven.

versions.title: Setup wizard released
versions.summary: The setup wizard replaces the old Render guide. The app code is the same as the version before it.

changes.text: Deploy target is GitHub Pages, not Render

versions.title: Daily jobs use your own project
versions.summary: The three daily and weekly jobs no longer point at the original project. They read the project address and key from your own database.

changes.text: Daily jobs sent calls to the original project
project_url and project_anon_key settings in automation_config

upgrade_steps.title: Get the new database changes
upgrade_steps.text: Run these commands in your repo folder.

upgrade_steps.title: Set your project address and key
upgrade_steps.text: Open the SQL Editor in Supabase. Replace PASTE_YOUR_ANON_KEY with your anon public key from Project Settings, API.
upgrade_steps.copy:
update public.automation_config set value = '{{supabase_url}}' where key = 'project_url';
update public.automation_config set value = 'PASTE_YOUR_ANON_KEY' where key = 'project_anon_key';

versions.title: Daily auto-fire of schedules
versions.summary: Scheduled content now fires each day without a manual step. WARNING: installs from this version until 2026-09-02 send the daily call to the original project. Upgrade these installs first.
